name: Ta Dung Lake
summary: The Dong Nai 3 reservoir spreads through Dak Glong with dozens of wooded islands and cool plateau air. Provincial pages call it the highlands’ Ha Long Bay. Boat from the Dak Som pier; separate fees may apply even when a park listing prints free entry.
timeNeeded: Half day to a full day
getThere: About 45 km from Gia Nghia on QL28
